pix/host/cmd/pix._prod_loc_note: Environment [[setup]] hooks (the v2 replacement for pack-authored install/auth hooks): a real capability addition, not accumulation. setup_cmd.go's runSetupHooks wires `pix setup --env NAME` to the envsetup runner (+1 edge for pix/host/envsetup) and env_cmd.go's renderTrustBill now prints each hook's id/kind/required/check argv/apply argv/sha256 in the DEFAULT consent screen, since a count is not consent.

pix/host/config._prod_loc_note: QA F5: config.Path/StateDir/DataDir/configDir now delegate to pixhome.Dir() (PIX_HOME) instead of re-deriving PIX_CONFIG/XDG_*/~/.config fallbacks inline — net prod_loc SHRANK (fewer resolution branches) but config now imports pixhome (edges 0 -> 1), closing the last executable-state escape.

pix/host/container._prod_loc_note: L1 (security re-review): authtoken.go adds RedactMemoryURLToken/RedactedTokenPlaceholder — the presentation-only redaction `pix env show --effective` uses so the pix-memory bearer token never reaches that display, while the canonical effective document a real launch composes still carries the real value. QA F4 (this round): memoryport.go adds EnsureMemoryPort/AllocateMemoryPortLocked/ReadMemoryPort/SetupLockPath — per-PIX_HOME port allocation under an advisory lock, replacing the single shared DefaultMemoryPort constant every install used to fight over (globals +1 for setupLockName, edges +1 for the new sys.Lock dependency). Round 5: memoryport.go's MemoryPort storage moved off the deleted pixhome.Machine schema onto config.Config (+1 edge for pix/host/config); container.go adds isDockerPortConflict/removeFailedCreate/dockerPortConflictMarkers so a real `docker create`/`docker start` bind-conflict error is classified into *PortInUseError and the orphaned just-created container is safely removed by ID before Setup's bounded reallocate-and-retry (+1 global for the marker slice, +78 prod_loc). Real capability change (round-5 blocker: port retry previously only worked via the pre-check, never the real docker error), not accumulation.

pix/host/envinfo._prod_loc_note: Environment [[setup]] hooks (the v2 replacement for pack-authored install/auth hooks): a real capability addition, not accumulation. sidecar.go adds the strict [[setup]] grammar: SetupHook + kind constants + EffectiveKind + validateSetupHooks/hasControlChars/hasDotDotSegment. Every field is refused at the exact file and line rather than defaulted, which is what the extra lines buy.

pix/host/envsetup._prod_loc_note: New L2 package: the environment [[setup]] hook runner (check, apply, check again) plus the executable-identity proof (HashSetupExecutable) both the trust bill and the pre-exec re-proof take. It owns the resolved-hook type so the fingerprinted value and the executed value cannot drift.

pix/host/health._prod_loc_note: Round-7: health.EnvironmentDefaultProbe + its environmentNames helper — the doctor remedy for "an environment exists but no default is selected" (pix env default NAME), never a guess. Final security findings: ProviderKeyProbe.Check's wired-but-unrouted detail named the removed v1 verb `pix models add`; it now names ModelKeyFix (`pix setup`), the one real v2 remedy.

pix/host/pixhome._prod_loc_note: QA F4: Machine gains a MemoryPort field (memory_port, setup-owned state) — a documented field addition, not accumulation.

pix/host/release._prod_loc_note: Final security findings (defense in depth): Manifest.Version was checked only for non-empty, yet flows unquoted into a filesystem path (RuntimeDir, extractRuntimeArchive's tar-entry prefix). Added versionRE + validateVersion — a conservative, semver-compatible [A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]* grammar refusing slash, backslash, dot-segments, and control characters — wired into Manifest.Validate (the one gate ParseBundleManifest/Parse both already call), so a traversal-shaped version is refused before any archive is staged.

pix/host/secret._prod_loc_note: SECURITY re-review MEDIUM finding fix: SetRef/RemoveRef in pixhome.go are now lock-protected (secretsEnvLockPath, +1 global for the lock-name const, +1 edge for the new pix/host/sys import) against a concurrent secrets.env writer — a real correctness fix, not accumulation.

pix/host/session._prod_loc_note: L2 (security re-review): limits.go adds pix_session_delegate's live-children-per-tree and max-depth caps (Limits/DefaultLimits/Store.CheckDelegateCaps/Store.Depth/Store.LiveNodeCount/Store.WithTreeLock), enforced atomically under one per-tree flock so concurrent delegate calls cannot race past the same cap (+1 edge: this package now imports pix/host/sys for the lock). mcp.go's Delegate wires the check-then-reserve section under that lock, refusing excess before anything is spawned or held. Real new capability with concurrent/depth/release test coverage, not accumulation.

pix/host/workflow/env._prod_loc_note: Environment [[setup]] hooks (the v2 replacement for pack-authored install/auth hooks): a real capability addition, not accumulation. bom.go adds computeSetupHooks and the SetupHookFact alias of envsetup.Hook (+1 edge for pix/host/envsetup), so the hook argv and executable content hash a human accepts are the exact value the runner later executes.

pix/host/workflow/launch._prod_loc_note: Review round 1 blocker #2 fix: FindPositivelyIdentified (the running-or-stopped identity check DecideEnvAttach's reattach gate now uses) and DecideEnvAttach's relaxed running-or-stopped gate. Real new logic (a stopped sandbox used to be refused outright by this gate), not accumulation. Round-7 adds EffectiveInferenceConfig: the production merge of a selected environment's pix.toml [inference.*] over machine config into an ephemeral, never-persisted snapshot for SynthesizeInferenceKit/CallableRuntimeModels/roster validation.
